criteria.label: Visible event
criteria.help: The objects and the event named in the prompt are actually visible.

criteria.label: Process
criteria.help: The event plays out as a process, not a jump between states.

criteria.label: Causality
criteria.help: Causes precede effects; contacts produce the right consequences.

criteria.label: Continuity
criteria.help: Objects persist and move continuously, without popping or swapping.

criteria.label: Physical plausibility
criteria.help: Motion, timing and final state obey physical law.
